title: Mixed Physical-Digital Task Benchmark
notes: 1 trial per task (14 real end-to-end runs), not repeated trials per task - this is a coverage benchmark across the 6 categories x 3 difficulty levels the task library was authored to span, not a reliability study (see E1 for repeated-trials reliability on a smaller task subset). A single real Gemini/CollectiveOS call chain is inherently noisy (see E1's transient-503 findings), so any one task's pass/fail here is a single data point, not a stable rate.

trials.goal: Detect the objects in the workspace.
Pick up the red_object and place it at the blue_container.
Inspect the red_object, then move to the blue_container, then stop.
Look up today's date using the computer.
Search the computer for the specification of part number PN-4471.
Inspect the red_object to read its display, then use the computer to log the reading you found.
Detect the objects present, then use the computer to search for a maintenance record for whichever object you found closest to the origin.
